title: Suction cups are persnickety and bottom basket is short
text:
Suction cups are persnickety and bottom basket is short. The bronze color on this is pretty and trendy for lots of bathrooms right now and the finish is smooth all the way around - no rough or sharp edges. There are some limitations on where and how it can be used though. For example..... Our master shower has both marble and glass and a removable shower head. The suction cups absolutely will not adhere to the marble with any weight in the caddy - it just pops off and everything bounces out. The cups do stick to the glass wall, but of course, that's not where the shower head is located. Meanwhile, the removable shower head means the entire hose has to hang in front of the caddy to be accessible and that in turn, blocks things in the top basket of the caddy.

I moved this to our guest bathroom with slightly better luck. There's a standard attached showerhead in there and simple ceramic tiles so the caddy fits correctly and the suction cups are holding. Now there's a new problem. The top basket is tall enough for standard shampoo & conditioner bottles, but the bottom basket is very short. It only holds those small tubes of facial scrubs and whatnot - if you have more than two full size bottles of hair stuff, a shaving gel and shower gel/wash then you will still need more space. As a guest bath unit with small size versions of those things, this unit will suffice.
